$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFMZ (AIP France, chart dated 2025-12-25): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Lézignan-Corbières

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT and ULM.
Simultaneous use of both RWY prohibited.
South AD traffic pattern: no turn before 500 ft ASFC during initial climb; downwind: overflight of the motorway at 1000 ft ASFC MNM.
Low height circuit: by the South, only with instructor on board; prohibited below 500 ft ASFC avoiding the overflight of the motorway.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Compulsory contact before startup with AFIS in order to know the PJE activity.
